description: List recent activity and publish events for posts, including status changes, publish attempts, failures, and retries, newest first. Use this as the agent notifications feed. The output says whether more events exist; page with offset (offset + limit up to 1000) or narrow with since or post_id before concluding nothing else happened.

limit.description: Number of items to return. Default 50, max 100.

offset.description: How many events to skip. Use the offset the previous page gives to get the next page.

since.description: ISO datetime. Return events created at or after this time.

type.description: Event source filter. Defaults to all.

workspace_id.description: Filter to a workspace ID from whoami.

name: list_activity
